driver_source:
"""Exercise the exact sandbox policy with a local trusted runtime and synthetic fixture."""
from hashlib import sha256
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

checkout = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(checkout / ".github/spikes/368"))
import admission

def digest(value):
    return sha256(value).hexdigest()

with TemporaryDirectory(prefix="aitm368-protected-discovery-", dir="/Users/Shared") as directory:
    root = Path(directory)
    admission.ROOT = root
    admission.STAGED = stage = root / "admitted"
    admission.SCRATCH = scratch = root / "worker"
    stage.mkdir()
    scratch.mkdir()
    source = root / "source"
    (source / "calibration").mkdir(parents=True)
    (source / "packages/aitm-usage").mkdir(parents=True)
    config = source / "packages/aitm-usage/pyproject.toml"
    shutil.copyfile(checkout / "packages/aitm-usage/pyproject.toml", config)
    fixture = source / "calibration/test_probe.py"
    shutil.copyfile(checkout / ".github/spikes/368/calibration.py", fixture)
    (root / "outside").write_text("synthetic protected marker\n")
    keygen = "/usr/bin/ssh-keygen"
    python = sys.executable
    native = str(Path(python).resolve())
    public_inputs = (str(source), sys.base_prefix, sys.prefix)
    executables = (keygen, native, python)
    protected = admission.boundary_profile(public_inputs, executables)
    original = protected.replace(f"(allow file-read-metadata (literal {json.dumps(str(root))}))\n", "")
    revised_policy = stage / "revised.sb"
    original_policy = stage / "original.sb"
    revised_policy.write_text(protected)
    original_policy.write_text(original)
    environment = {"PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin", "LC_ALL": "C", "HOME": str(scratch),
                   "TMPDIR": str(scratch), "PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD": "1"}

    def launch(policy, opts):
        args = ("/usr/bin/sandbox-exec", "-f", str(policy), python, "-B", "-I", "-m", "pytest")
        return subprocess.run((*args, *opts), cwd=source, env=environment, capture_output=True, text=True)

    basic = ("-p", "no:cacheprovider", "--rootdir", str(source))
    exact = (*basic, "-c", str(config), "--confcutdir", str(source))
    rejected = launch(original_policy, (*basic, "--collect-only", "--full-trace", "-q", str(fixture)))
    assert rejected.returncode == 2, (rejected.returncode, rejected.stderr, rejected.stdout)
    assert "PermissionError: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted: '" + str(root) + "'" in rejected.stdout, rejected.stdout
    frames = re.findall(r"(^[^\n]+/_pytest/config/__init__\.py):(\d+):[ \t]*$", rejected.stdout, re.M)
    assert frames and "def _get_directory(path:" in rejected.stdout, rejected.stdout
    collected = launch(revised_policy, (*exact, "--collect-only", "-q", str(fixture)))
    expected = ["calibration/test_probe.py::test_failure", "calibration/test_probe.py::test_success"]
    assert collected.returncode == 0 and collected.stdout.splitlines()[:2] == expected, collected.stdout+collected.stderr
    control = stage / "read-controls.py"
    control.write_text("""import errno, os, sys
os.stat(sys.argv[1])
print("ALLOW admission root metadata")
for fn, file, label in [
    (os.listdir, sys.argv[1], "admission root listing"),
    (os.stat, sys.argv[2], "admission root child metadata"),
]:
    try:
        fn(file)
    except OSError as error:
        assert error.errno in (errno.EPERM, errno.EACCES)
        print("DENY " + label)
    else:
        raise AssertionError(label)
""")
    protection = subprocess.run(("/usr/bin/sandbox-exec", "-f", str(revised_policy), python, "-B", "-I",
                                 str(control), str(root), str(root/"outside")), cwd=source, env=environment,
                                capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert not protection.returncode, (protection.stdout,protection.stderr)
    rows = []
    for name, target, state in (
        ("positive", str(fixture) + "::test_success", 0),
        ("failure", str(fixture) + "::test_failure", 1),
        ("failure-with-sibling", str(fixture), 1),
    ):
        run = launch(revised_policy, (*exact, "--basetemp", str(scratch/name), "--maxfail=1", "-q", target))
        assert run.returncode == state, (name, run.returncode, run.stdout, run.stderr)
        expect = "1 passed" if state == 0 else "1 failed"
        assert expect in run.stdout, (name, run.stdout)
        rows.append({"case":name, "exit":run.returncode, "summary":run.stdout.splitlines()[-1]})
    print(json.dumps({
        "profile_sha256": digest(revised_policy.read_bytes()), "original_profile_sha256": digest(original_policy.read_bytes()),
        "profile": protected, "original_profile": original,
        "substitutions":{"ROOT":str(root), "STAGED":str(stage),"SCRATCH":str(scratch),
                         "INPUTS":public_inputs,"EXECUTABLES":executables},
        "original":{"exit":rejected.returncode,"denied_path":str(root),"errno":1,
                    "last_pytest_frame":{"file":frames[-1][0].split("/_pytest/")[-1],
                                         "line":int(frames[-1][1]),"function":"_get_directory"},
                    "stdout_sha256":digest(rejected.stdout.encode())},
        "revised":{"options":exact, "exit":collected.returncode, "node_ids":expected,
                   "raw_stdout":collected.stdout, "stdout_sha256":digest(collected.stdout.encode())},
        "protection_stdout":protection.stdout,
        "calibration_outcomes_local_synthetic":rows,
    }, indent=2))
